muc.title: Watched it, forgot it all
muc.text: You watch a lecture video and feel like you understand everything. The next day someone asks you about it, and your mind goes blank. You're not slow. It's a trap everyone falls into.

muc.title: Familiar isn't the same as remembering
muc.text: When you watch or reread, everything looks familiar, so you think you understand. But recognizing something is different from recalling it yourself.

muc.title: Recall it yourself
muc.text: Memory research shows that answering questions yourself helps you remember longer than rereading many times. This is called retrieval practice.

muc.title: Interactive learning
muc.text: Interactive learning turns you from a watcher into a doer: answer questions in the middle of a lesson, ask about the hard parts, try your own examples.

muc.title: A study buddy, 24/7
muc.text: It used to take a teacher sitting next to you to quiz you. Now AI can do that with any video or document you're studying.

muc.title: Pause every 5 minutes
muc.text: Next time you watch a video to learn, pause every five minutes and say one summary sentence out loud. If you can't, rewind.

muc.title: Turn videos into lessons
muc.text: Part two: ask AI to turn any video into a lesson with questions.
